meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会调用Dial的`dial`命令，用分配给你的真实电话号码发短信、拨打由AI语音代理接听的电话，并监听收到的短信或验证码。它按内置文档执行，不向你索要密钥。
howto.when: 当你说到电话、短信、验证码等，或要求打电话、发短信、等收码时触发；也会在你首次运行 `dial` 命令前、或想了解 Dial 能做什么时生效。

say.text: 帮我给 +14155550123 发条短信，说我晚到十分钟。
say.note: 会用`dial message`发送真实短信。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打电话，让 AI 通知对方会议改到明天。
say.note: 将发起AI语音电话并按指令表达。

say.text: 等下会有个验证码发到你那个号码，收到了把内容告诉我。
say.note: 等待入站短信并读取验证码。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Dial `dial` CLI with your provisioned real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes. It follows the built-in reference and won't ask for an API key.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, SMS, verification codes, or ask to text, call, or wait for a code; also before your first `dial` command in a session or when exploring Dial's capabilities.

say_en.text: Send a text to +14155550123 saying I will be ten minutes late.
say_en.note: Uses dial message to send a real SMS.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and have the AI tell them the meeting moved to tomorrow.
say_en.note: Places an AI voice call with that instruction.

say_en.text: A verification code will be sent to your number; let me know when it arrives.
say_en.note: Waits for inbound SMS and reads the code.
